subject: Pricing & model mix follow-up / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + pricing ask (post-demo)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the demo with us today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a tailored pricing/MA plan: 

Call recap (high-level):
- Use case: search + chat assistant for customers on web + mobile, plus embeddings for similarity search and a small rerank pipeline for search quality.
- KPIs: median latency <300ms for chat, sub-100ms for embeddings lookup; cost target below your current run-rate by 25%.
- Timeline: pilot with ~2 teams starting in Q2, ramp in Q3.

Pricing/volume info we need to qualify:
1) Expected monthly token volumes by model type (rough is fine): chat (prompt+resp combined), embeddings (requests and avg tokens per request), rerank (tokens per rerank + calls).
2) Target budget range for hosted inference (monthly). If you have a desired $/1M tokens target, please share.
3) Any hard constraints (SLA/region/compliance) that would affect Dedicated vs Hosted.

From the call I captured the following rough split — can you confirm or correct?
- Chat (interactive assistant): 60% of token volume
- Embeddings (search & similarity): 30%
- Rerank (small-scale model for result tuning): 10%

We’ll use those numbers to size pricing bands and suggest model/quantization mixes that meet your latency and cost targets. Attaching our standard pricing bands and a draft SOW template so you can see assumptions.

Next steps: if you can reply with the rough monthly volumes and budget range, Dev will put together a cost estimate and recommended model mix + rollout plan.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-pricing-bands.pdf, SOW-draft-Acme-2026.pdf

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + pricing ask (post-demo)

Hi Marissa —

Great demo — thanks. Below are the best estimates from our side after syncing with Priya (head of Search). These are month-1 expected (pilot) with a 3x–5x ramp over 6 months.

Estimated monthly volumes (pilot):
- Chat assistant: ~120M tokens/month (avg 2k sessions/day, ~60 tokens promt + 250 tokens response avg)
- Embeddings: ~400k requests/month, avg 768 tokens embedding input (~307M tokens equivalent if counted that way) — we usually price embeddings separately per request but also want a per-token view.
- Rerank: ~50M tokens/month (small model applied to top-10 results, ~50 tokens per rerank)

Budget guidance:
- Pilot monthly budget: $5k–$10k (tight)
- Target steady-state budget after ramp: ~$30k/month (flexible if unit economics improve)
- Our rough internal target: <$30 per 1M chat tokens (for prompt+response combined) — embeddings we expect to be ~$10–$20 per 1M-token-equivalent but prefer per-embedding pricing.

Constraints: hosted is preferred for speed of start; we may revisit Dedicated for cost predictability once volumes >2B tokens/month.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Search & Personalization
Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + pricing ask (post-demo)

Alex — thanks, this is super helpful and exactly what we needed. A few clarifying Qs so we size correctly: 

1) Embeddings pricing preference — do you prefer a per-embedding unit price (per request) or want us to show both per-request and per-1M-token equivalent? We can show both, but for procurement they often like per-request.
2) For chat tokens — can you confirm whether the 120M includes both prompt + response (I think you said yes).
3) Rerank details — is the 50 tokens/rerank an average across queries or a conservative upper bound?

For transparency on our side: attached is a quick banded sketch of pricing (redwood-pricing-bands.pdf). For your target of <$30 / 1M chat tokens, we can show two options: Hosted with optimized batching and model selection (likely a mix of quantized 8-bit models optimized for latency) or Dedicated reserved capacity which hits lower $/1M at higher commit levels. We’ll put numbers against your ramp profile.

Dev — can you draft two sample month-1 costings against Alex’s pilot numbers (hosted) and a 12-month ramp to 1B tokens (with a Dedicated estimate) — include per-model splits and an effective $/1M tokens for the blended mix. Also include per-embedding request pricing and a rerank per-1M-token equivalent line so procurement can compare apples-to-apples.

Alex — once we have that, would you prefer a short (30m) review call or would you like the slides + SOW first for internal review?

Cheers,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + pricing ask (post-demo)

Hi Alex / Marissa — looping in a quick cost sketch (summary below). Full calc attached in redwood-pricing-bands.pdf; I'll follow with a short spreadsheet.

Assumptions (pilot month):
- Chat: 120M tokens (prompt+response), model: mix of chat-small (quantized) 60% + chat-medium (fp16) 40% to meet latency/SLA.
- Embeddings: 400k requests (we’ll present per-embedding price); equivalent tokens shown for comparability.
- Rerank: 50M tokens at small model (optimized).

Pilot hosted estimate (ballpark):
- Chat blended unit: $28 / 1M tokens -> chat cost: $3,360/month
- Embeddings: $0.015 / request -> embeddings cost: $6,000/month (alt view: ~$19.5 / 1M-token-equivalent)
- Rerank: $20 / 1M tokens -> rerank cost: $1,000/month
- Total pilot run-rate (hosted): ~$10.4k/month (within your $5–10k target on the high side; we can tighten by increasing chat-small fraction and more caching)

12-month ramp to 1B tokens (Dedicated sketch):
- Blended effective $/1M tokens: $12–18 depending on commit and model mix
- Embeddings per-request: $0.009–$0.012 at higher commit tiers

Next steps: I’ll share a 1-page cost slide + a 2nd tab with a model-mix toggle (chat/emb/rerank splits) so you can see sensitivity. Also happy to run a short 30-min pricing review this week — available Thu 11am or Fri 2pm PT.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-bands.pdf

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@acme-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + pricing ask (post-demo)

Thanks Dev — that looks sensible and aligns with our internal targets. A couple quick asks: 
- Can you send the per-model breakdown slide (chat-small vs chat-medium assumptions) and the spreadsheet so we can run against our internal traffic shape?
- Let’s tentatively book Fri 2pm PT for the pricing review — Priya will join. If you can send calendar invite, I’ll accept.

Also, we prefer per-embedding per-request pricing in procurement materials; please include that prominently.

If you can also drop a short SOW with milestones (pilot acceptance criteria + metrics) that would help fast-track procurement.

Appreciate it —
Alex
